obligations.feature: Archive with confirmation, refusing while a git operation is in progress, recording an archive commit
obligations.gap: #391 (274ac80) replaces the row-only db_archive_workspace with archive_workspace (src-tauri/src/workspace_archive/, flow.rs), which the row menu, WorkspaceView, the palette and archive on merge all reach through startArchive (store.ts). It follows Conductor's dYe/mYe (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @ ~966,478 / ~969,254): checkpoint conductor-archive-<id>, refuse in safe mode while a merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert is in progress with the sticky warning and Archive retry (discardGitOperationState), archive commit = HEAD kept under refs/conductor-archive-heads/<id>, row state/branch/archive_commit, archive script, .context move, worktree removal and delete_branch_on_archive. #397 (aa32456) closes the last gap: the running-agents check folds every chat of the workspace (workspaceAgentStatus; working, cancelling or waiting block, as dYe), and every archive calls stopWorkspaceAgents, which stops each working or cancelling chat of the workspace (stopChat), as Conductor's Z$ (@974,859) calls cancelSession for every session of a local workspace. Conductor's cancel also settles a 'waiting' session (@3,013,752); no OpenConductor chat reports 'waiting', so there is nothing to settle. Read on f6c05d7 with the bundle (sha256 prefix b5b01f33); not run in the desktop app. Re-read on 1944b98: partial, because 'every chat' covers only Reason chats. chatStatuses is published only by createChatRuntime (chatRuntime.ts), which only reasonChat.ts uses; codexChat.ts keeps its own queue and never publishes a status, and stopWorkspaceAgents calls reasonChat's stopChat. So a working Codex chat neither blocks archive nor is stopped by 'Stop agents and archive', and its worktree is removed under it, unlike Conductor's Z$, which cancels every session of the workspace (gap reported in #437's body). In progress: draft PR #467 (head f2f5d1e, builder aebd8c64, stacked on #428's branch, lands after #428) makes 'Stop agents and archive' cancel Codex chats too; open and held, so it is not scored until it merges.
obligations.done_when: the gap in `why` is closed and the feature matches the cited evidence end to end

obligations.feature: Row status icon from workspace state, then the sessions' aggregated status, then PR state, else branch/local (not the manual Backlog/In progress status, which only groups the status-grouped sidebar)
obligations.gap: On 66a892a the row icon follows Conductor's chain: rowStatus({workspaceState: ws.state, session, pr: ws.pr}). #370 closed two gaps: the session status is now aggregated over every chat of the workspace (reasonChat chatStatuses -> workspaceSessionStatus, nTr order), and every on-screen row polls its PR every 5 minutes like Conductor's G5e (sidebarPrPoll.ts / sidebarPrPoller.ts, batched per repository), so PR states reach rows that are not open and come back after a restart once the row is on screen. Still missing: the chat queue's SessionStatus is only idle/working/cancelling/error, so needs_plan_response, needs_user_permission, needs_user_input and waiting never reach the icon.
